description: WP-C item 5: radial single-lump phase control (phi = Phi cos theta, phi_t = -omega Phi sin theta)

params.scheme: swirl.family.radial.Radial: u = r phi, 4th-order FD, RK4

definitions.frac: E(r < 3 hw, t) / E_total(t = 0) of the same run
definitions.frac_vs_theta0_E0: E(r < 3 hw, t) / E_total(t = 0) of the theta = 0 run
definitions.omega_at_T: median of 2 pi / (upward zero-crossing period of phi(0,t)) over periods with midpoint in [T-50, T]
definitions.death_time: first t > 50 with E(r<3hw) < 0.5 E(r<3hw, t=50)

criterion.text: SESSION_02_PREDICTIONS.md WP-C block: |frac_theta(T) - frac_0(T)| <= 0.01 at T = 300, 500, 1000; omega within 0.005; no death
